title: Shark's predictable BYOVD marker overwrites an existing file
recommendation: Create the marker exclusively through a held no-follow, single-link regular-file handle; refuse pre-existing output and bind the step to the created object's identity.

title: Shark Stop & clean deletes a replacement at a recorded path
recommendation: Delete only the exact drill-created object through held object identity/custody; fail closed on changed identity instead of unlinking a replacement path.

title: Historical AAR tab displays unauthenticated text as a report
recommendation: Authenticate the paired archive JSON and exact text SHA-256 before listing or showing historical text; reject unsafe links and show unverified status on failure.

title: Drill history and stale-cleanup reads are unbounded on the UI/run path
recommendation: Apply per-file byte, candidate, and time budgets; stream marker checks and move archive reads/verification off the Qt thread.
